title: Friday Night Magic 2000: card flavor text

entities.name: Afari
entities.description: Author of Tales, quoted on the snake's hiss for peace and the elephant's trumpeting of war.

entities.name: Roya
entities.description: A Zhalfirin archer who vows to pin winged creatures to the skies over Tefemburu.

entities.name: Tefemburu
entities.description: Place whose skies Roya vows to defend.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Crew member of the Weatherlight who orders defenders to hold position.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: People with a saying that lightning tethers souls to the world.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: People who share a riddle about thunder and lightning.

events.summary: Roya vows to pin any winged creature to the skies over Tefemburu.
events.quote: If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu.

events.summary: Tahngarth orders defenders to hold their position and leave doubt for the dying.
events.quote: Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!
